title: A converted or consenting practice's kept summary
assertion: Frozen at conversion (or at completion with consent and a withdrawal link) with the result's sums, the attribution, the labels' version and the first open; every claim-line sum 0 or at least 11; the left-out sums only at 11 or more; kept 12 months, then deleted with its products; withdrawn or deleted with its request; any other delete refused
noFileReason: A kept summary is frozen by the database from a screening the tests run in memory; no file.
